title: CaliaCorp 3 – Apply Now!
description:
For those who’ve been part of it before… you know what to expect. Weekly tasks, with a choice of teams to join at CaliaCorp!

Those who complete all their tasks this August will be getting a bonus file JUST FOR THEM as a reward! That means an exclusive piece of content that most people will never, ever hear.

All you need to take part is an email address, just fill out the form below and join the fastest growing company on the planet, led by the CEO that Forbes described as ‘Yes Mistress we will promote you Mistress’.

It’s business, but not as usual!

AND you can look forward to a file series in August that takes CaliaCorp into the future – we’re leaping ahead in time and seeing what happens when CaliaCorp takes over the world… and finding out what exactly PROJECT SUCCU8U5 is.

I can’t wait for you to see and hear what I’ve got in store.

SIGN UP NOW TO BE A PART OF IT!

CaliaCorp is a mass participation event, with a femdom twist. You’ll do whatever I ask to help me promote myself, and my company… CaliaCorp! I know you want to please me, time to show me just how much AND unlock rewards!
author: Mistress Calia
